correctness.rationale: Read complete fixed-tree RESULT.md and both separately named functional-graph/direct simulation scripts in actual Git tree. The conserved offset p-k mod n reduces full rotor states to binary words updated by flipping bit indexed by popcount mod n. Explicit recurrent words A_j and B_j form a 2n orbit; monotone displacement potentials E_B, E_A count the upward/downward flips until entry, proving the statewise exact preperiod. Rearrangement proves maximal preperiod and exactly two optimizing words in each offset class; the rightmost-one tail sum and symmetry prove the mean. Independently enumerated all binary words n=3..10, computed true recurrence-entry from the complete functional graph and verified the formula, max count, recurrent count and exact mean. Finite census supports but does not replace the all-n argument.
